Thanks for the crash report — the auto-generated stack trace pointed straight at it.

**Root cause:** .NET 10 removed `BinaryFormatter`. The exit confirmation dialog (`frmTaskDialog`, shown from `FrmMain_FormClosing`) was loading an `ImageList` whose images were stored in the old binary-serialized resource format.
